name: Colourfastness to Rubbing
description: Dry and wet rubbing colourfastness, graded 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) on the grey scale

name: Shrinkage Test
description: Dimensional change (length and width) after domestic washing and drying

name: Abrasion Resistance
description: Martindale abrasion: cycles to specimen breakdown

name: Tear Strength
description: Tear strength using the pendulum (Elmendorf) method

name: Zip Strength Test
description: Zip pull strength: force to detach puller, slider and tape from the chain

name: Seam Strength
description: Seam strength and seam slippage under tension (grab method)

name: Water Resistance Spray Test
description: Spray test for surface wetting resistance, rated 0 to 100. New fabric conditioned at 20C and 65% RH; a finish is normally rated after one soft-water wash

name: DWR Wash Durability
description: Spray rating after repeated ISO 6330 4N domestic washes in soft water at 40C, line-dried between washes, new fabric with no abrasion or tumble-drying; reported at 5, 10 and 20 washes

name: Hydrostatic Head
description: Water penetration pressure (mm water column), including seams

name: Drop Test - 1.2m
description: Drop test from 1.2m height on faces, edges and corners

name: Crush Test
description: Compression test for package crushing

name: Drop and Crush
description: Combined drop and crush test

name: Chromium VI Test
description: Hexavalent chromium (Cr VI) in leather, mg/kg; limit 3 mg/kg

name: Heavy Metals Test
description: Migration of lead, cadmium, chromium and other heavy metals

name: Food Contact Migration
description: Overall and specific migration from food-contact stainless steel, silicone and plastics

name: Small Parts and Use-and-Abuse
description: Small parts cylinder, torque and tension tests for choking hazards, e.g. removable straw tips
applies_to: children's products, small parts, choking hazard, bottles, straw tip

name: Lead in Surface Coatings
description: Total lead in paint and surface coatings of children's products
applies_to: children's products, painted surfaces, bottles, lead

name: Labelling and Age Warning Review
description: Check of labels, age grading, warnings and traceability marks
applies_to: labelling, age warnings, children's products, bottles

name: Battery Safety (Li-ion)
description: Safety of lithium cells and batteries: overcharge, short circuit, thermal abuse

description: Lithium battery transport tests: altitude, thermal, vibration, shock, short circuit

name: EMC Test
description: Electromagnetic emissions and immunity

name: Electrical Safety
description: Electrical and fire safety of USB-charged electronic products
applies_to: electrical, USB-C charging, smart bottle, connected products, CE, UKCA

description: Breaking force of fabric strips
